description: CSS deep review: responsive fixes, z-index consistency, rem units, hover states, and dead CSS cleanup in bloomberg.css
steps: In dashboard/static/css/bloomberg.css: (a) Audit and remove any unused CSS classes (dead CSS) - search for classes defined in CSS but never referenced in any template; be conservative, only remove clearly dead ones
(b) Ensure all CSS custom properties (variables) have values in both dark theme (default) and any light theme variant if it exists (check for :root or [data-theme] selectors)
(c) Add media query rules for .market-tile, .datasource-card, .report-scorecard at 375px width to prevent overflow (ensure they use 100% width, text truncation with overflow-hidden/text-overflow)
(d) Convert any remaining px-based font-size declarations to rem (except for fixed-size elements like icons) for consistency
(e) Verify z-index layering: toast notifications > modal > sidebar > main content. Add/fix z-index values if needed: toast=9999, modal=1000, sidebar=100, content=1
(f) Add :hover and :focus-visible styles to all interactive elements (.btn, .ticker-btn, .example-chip, .mover-item, .hot-ticker-card, nav links) that lack them
acceptance_criteria: No CSS class is defined but never used in templates (or clearly justified as dynamic)
.market-tile does not overflow at 375px viewport width
All font-size values use rem (with documented exceptions for special cases)
z-index hierarchy: toast > modal > sidebar > content is correct
All clickable elements have visible hover/focus states
findings: Removed dead CSS classes (badge-dim, badge-green, badge-red, flag-cn, data-mono, unit-hint). Converted all font-size px to rem (14px->0.875rem, 12px->0.75rem, 16px->1rem). Fixed z-index hierarchy: progress-bar=99999, toast=9999, sidebar=100, backdrop=99, hamburger=98, content=1. Added comprehensive @media (max-width: 375px) rules for single-column collapse on market-tile, datasource-card, report-scorecard, hot-ticker-card, macro-card. Added hover/focus-visible states for mover-item, hot-ticker-card, example-chip, ticker-btn, preset-btn, school-filter-btn, market-tile, macro-card, form inputs, and more. All 448 tests pass.
